title: On a local variant of the 12th Delfino problem -- the $Σ$-side
summary: Assuming that $M_n$, the canonical inner model with $n$ Woodin cardinals, exists, we force a model in which every $\boldsymbolΣ^1_{n+2}$ set is Lebesgue measurable and has the Baire property, and in which $Σ^1_{n+2+m}$-uniformization holds for every $m\inω$. Additionally, this universe has a $Δ^1_{n+3}$-definable wellorder of the reals. This answers a question of S. D. Friedman and R. Schindler from 1999.
